# polaris_catalog (Resource)

Manages a Polaris catalog: an INTERNAL catalog managed by Polaris, or an EXTERNAL one, optionally federated to a remote catalog service through `connection_config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Internal catalog on S3
resource "polaris_catalog" "lakehouse" {
  name                  = "lakehouse"
  default_base_location = "s3://my-bucket/lakehouse"

  properties = {
    "owner" = "data-platform"
  }

  storage_config = {
    storage_type      = "S3"
    role_arn          = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/polaris-lakehouse"
    region            = "eu-west-1"
    allowed_locations = ["s3://my-bucket/lakehouse", "s3://my-bucket/shared"]
  }
}

# External catalog federated to a remote Iceberg REST catalog
resource "polaris_catalog" "remote" {
  name                  = "remote"
  type                  = "EXTERNAL"
  default_base_location = "s3://my-bucket/remote"

  storage_config = {
    storage_type = "S3"
    role_arn     = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/polaris-remote"
  }

  connection_config = {
    connection_type     = "ICEBERG_REST"
    uri                 = "https://remote.example.com/api/catalog"
    remote_catalog_name = "analytics"

    authentication = {
      type          = "OAUTH"
      token_uri     = "https://remote.example.com/api/catalog/v1/oauth/tokens"
      client_id     = var.remote_client_id
      client_secret = var.remote_client_secret
      scopes        = ["PRINCIPAL_ROLE:ALL"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_base_location` (String) Default base location for the catalog's tables, e.g. `s3://bucket/prefix`. It must be within one of the storage `allowed_locations`.
- `name` (String) The name of the catalog. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `storage_config` (Attributes) Storage configuration. Set the attributes for the chosen `storage_type`; settings the server fills in are read back after apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_config))

### Optional

- `connection_config` (Attributes) EXTERNAL catalogs only: connection to the remote catalog service to federate. Requires the `ENABLE_CATALOG_FEDERATION` feature on the server. The management API cannot update a connection, so any change, including a new secret, forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_config))
- `properties` (Map of String) Additional catalog properties. `default-base-location` is managed with `default_base_location` and must not be set here.
- `type` (String) The catalog type: `INTERNAL` (default) or `EXTERNAL`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Version of the catalog object, used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `service_identity_iam_arn` (String) For federated catalogs, the ARN of the IAM identity Polaris uses to reach the remote service, if the server reports one.

<a id="nestedatt--storage_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_config`

Required:

- `storage_type` (String) Storage type: `S3`, `GCS`, `AZURE` or `FILE` (testing only). Polaris cannot change it in place, so changing it forces a new resource.

Optional:

- `allowed_locations` (Set of String) Locations the catalog may use. Polaris always adds `default_base_location`.
- `consent_url` (String) AZURE: URL of the Azure permissions request page.
- `credential_vending_mechanism` (String) S3: how Polaris vends subscoped credentials, e.g. `STS`. Empty uses the server default.
- `decryption_keys` (List of String) S3: KMS key ARNs that can only decrypt data.
- `encryption_keys` (List of String) S3: KMS key ARNs that can encrypt (and decrypt) data.
- `endpoint` (String) S3: endpoint for S3 requests, as seen by clients.
- `endpoint_internal` (String) S3: endpoint Polaris uses for S3 requests instead of `endpoint`.
- `external_id` (String) S3: external ID used in the role's trust policy.
- `gcs_service_account` (String) GCS: Google Cloud Storage service account.
- `hierarchical` (Boolean) AZURE: scope SAS tokens to the most specific path. Only for storage accounts with hierarchical namespace.
- `kms_unavailable` (Boolean) S3: if true, Polaris does not add KMS key policies.
- `multi_tenant_app_name` (String) AZURE: name of the Azure client application.
- `path_style_access` (Boolean) S3: use path-style bucket addressing.
- `region` (String) S3: region where the data is stored.
- `role_arn` (String) S3: ARN of the IAM role granting access to the buckets.
- `storage_name` (String) Name of a server-side storage configuration to use.
- `sts_endpoint` (String) S3: endpoint for STS requests made by Polaris.
- `sts_unavailable` (Boolean) S3: if true, Polaris does not use STS, which disables credential vending.
- `tenant_id` (String) AZURE: tenant ID the storage accounts belong to. Required for AZURE.
- `user_arn` (String) S3: ARN of the IAM user Polaris uses to assume `role_arn`.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_config`

Required:

- `authentication` (Attributes) How Polaris authenticates to the remote service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_config--authentication))
- `connection_type` (String) Remote catalog type: `ICEBERG_REST`, `HADOOP`, `HIVE` or `BIGQUERY`.

Optional:

- `properties` (Map of String) Additional connection properties (for BIGQUERY: `gcp.bigquery.project-id` and `warehouse`).
- `remote_catalog_name` (String) ICEBERG_REST: name of the catalog in the remote service (often called the warehouse).
- `uri` (String) URI of the remote catalog service.
- `warehouse` (String) HADOOP / HIVE: warehouse location.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_config--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_config.authentication`

Required:

- `type` (String) Authentication type: `OAUTH`, `BEARER`, `SIGV4`, `IMPLICIT` or `GCP`.

Optional:

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) BEARER: token. Never returned by the API, so not available after import.
- `client_id` (String) OAUTH: client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAUTH: client secret. Never returned by the API, so not available after import.
- `external_id` (String) SIGV4: external ID used in the role's trust policy.
- `role_arn` (String) SIGV4: ARN of the IAM role Polaris assumes to sign requests.
- `role_session_name` (String) SIGV4: role session name.
- `scopes` (List of String) OAUTH: scopes requested with the token.
- `session_policy` (String) SIGV4: IAM session policy (JSON) restricting the assumed role.
- `signing_name` (String) SIGV4: service name used to sign requests (server default `execute-api`).
- `signing_region` (String) SIGV4: region used to sign requests.
- `token_uri` (String) OAUTH: token endpoint URI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a catalog by name. Connection secrets (client_secret, bearer_token)
# are not returned by the API and must be set again in the configuration.
terraform import polaris_catalog.lakehouse lakehouse
```
